loot_read: Read current selections, request counters and the runtime affix ID/name list.
loot_mode: All items, the current loot filter, Unique LP or wanted T7 quality, or crafting materials. Enable auto pickup separately.
loot_lp: Quality mode accepts a Unique at this LP threshold, a Unique with the Minimum Weaver's Will, or an item with a wanted T7 affix.
loot_ww: Quality mode also accepts a Unique with at least this much Weaver's Will (0 = off). A Weaver's Will Unique has no Legendary Potential, so Minimum Unique LP alone never picks it up.
loot_t7: Enable the wanted T7 condition in quality mode.
loot_filter: Respect the loot filter in quality mode
Quality items must also pass the current filter. Filter mode always respects it.
loot_affixes: Search and sort the available affixes, then double-click to move choices between the two lists. Choose up to 64; an empty wanted list accepts any T7 affix.
loot_category: Choose crafting materials, gold, potions, XP tomes, Favor tomes, Ancient Bones or Memory Amber, Soul Embers and XP motes ("amber") independently.
loot_reset: Restore all/default selections. Auto pickup keeps its current on/off state.
craft_read: Read native forge eligibility, item FP and affixes, shard craft cost ranges and glyph chances. Exact RNG outcomes are unknown.
craft_runes: Return only the rune actually consumed by a normal forge attempt. You still need a rune to start; other item rules remain.
craft_glyphs: Return only the glyph actually consumed by a normal forge attempt. Does not add materials or override item eligibility.
craft_level: Ignore the selected affix upgrade's level check in the local forge. Character level, equipment requirements and other forge rules remain unchanged.
craft_forge: Select the item, shard or rune and optional glyph in the game's forge first. This button performs one eligible craft and creates a backup. It never repeats automatically.
map_reveal: Show the full minimap and overlay. Switch off to restore normal fog of war. Exploration saves, monsters and quests remain unchanged.
map_read: Read whether the zone map is available, revealed and using active hooks.
craft_fp: 0 is free, 1 is normal. Fractional loss rounds upward. Native crafting eligibility remains in effect.
craft_hope: Choose 0-100 percent or reset to the native chance. Requires Basic Glyph of Hope.
craft_despair: Choose 0-100 percent or reset to the native chance. Native eligibility and T1-T4 limits remain in effect.
craft_shards: Refund the one shard actually consumed by a normal craft. Rune and glyph preservation have separate switches.
craft_reset: Restore FP cost 1, native glyph chances, normal material consumption and affix level checks. Remove all crafting hooks.
xp: Increases XP gained from enemies and experience motes. Quest rewards are unchanged.
gold: Multiplies gold gained from normal gold pickups.
bones: Multiplies the Ancient Bones that drop for you, rounded: the pile on the ground already shows the larger amount and picking it up gives that much. Bones you already have and what you spend do not change. Offline only; off at 1.
amber: Multiplies the Memory Amber that a member of The Woven gains. Reputation earned with that amber rises with it. Offline only; off at 1.
drops: Increases the number of items dropped by enemies. Circle of Fortune bonuses also apply.
density: Increases the average size of future eligible normal packs. Existing packs, bosses and special spawns are unchanged.
rarity: Each normal rarity roll has a (x-1)/x chance of moving up one tier. Exalted and T7 rolls have separate controls.
lprolls: The game rolls a new Unique's Legendary Potential this many times and keeps the highest roll, never above what the game itself can roll (drops, rewards and its other Legendary Potential rolls). More rolls give higher Legendary Potential; how high it can go still depends on the area level and corruption. Weaver's Will Uniques and items you already have do not change. Offline only; off at 1.
fpdrops: Multiplies the Forging Potential of new Normal, Magic, Rare and Exalted items (drops, rewards, Nemesis and Spawn Items), rounded, up to 63, the most an item can have in the game: at x2 an item that would drop with 20 gets 40. Crafting uses it up as usual. Shops, gamblers and items you already have do not change; Uniques and Sets have none. Offline only; off at 1.
uniqueroll: New Uniques, Set items and Legendaries roll their values in the best part of each range: at 80 every value comes from the best fifth of its range, at 100 every value is the best it can be (a perfect roll). The game decides which end is best for each value, so a downside rolls as small as it can. Drops, rewards, Nemesis, Spawn Items and Weaver cocoons when they open; gamblers and items you already have do not change. Offline only; off at 0.
weaverswill: Multiplies the Weaver's Will the game rolls for a Unique (drops, rewards and opened cocoons), up to the game's maximum of 28: at x2 a Unique that would roll 10 gets 20. Items you already have do not change. Offline only; off at 1.
weaversdrop: Percent of the Uniques that drop (and other Uniques the game picks at random) that come as a Weaver's Will Unique, where one fits the same item type, level and drop rules. The game's own share is about 4 %; 0 keeps it. Offline only.
weaversupgrades: When a kill near you gives an equipped Weaver's Will item an upgrade (at most once every 15 seconds), it happens this many times: each upgrade adds an affix or raises one by a tier and uses 1 Weaver's Will. Offline only; off at 1.
idolprefixes: The game gives an idol one prefix and a Rare idol altar two. With 2 or 3, each idol that drops (and idols from rewards, Nemesis and Spawn Items) rolls 1 to this many prefixes and each idol altar 2 to one more than this many, picked by the game's own rules for that item: its level, type and class, no repeats, the usual weights and tiers. A Weaver idol can get more Weaver affixes this way too. Shops, gamblers, Heretical idols and items you already have do not change. Offline only; the game's own at 1.
idolsuffixes: The same for suffixes: each new idol rolls 1 to this many suffixes, each new idol altar 2 to one more than this many. Offline only; the game's own at 1.
enchanteruses: Each Woven Enchanter you meet allows this many times its usual uses, so you can reforge more idols there: at 20, "1/1 uses remain" becomes 20/20. It also applies to an Enchanter you are standing at. Each craft still costs its Memory Amber. Offline only; the game's own at 1.
weaver_affixes: Affixes that Weaver's Will upgrades prefer: an upgrade raises one of these when the item has one below T7, and a new affix is one of these when one fits the item. Otherwise the game chooses as usual. None: the game chooses every upgrade.
weaver_read: Read the Weaver's Will Unique share, upgrade speed, wanted affixes and their counters.
speed: Adds increased movement speed equal to x-1. Shares the same contribution as the movement speed stat editor.
cooldown: Reduces cooldowns and speeds up normal charge regeneration.
autopickup: Automatically collects items and resources by your Pickup mode and Pickup category choices. Pauses while you inspect an item.
density_read: Shows pack and generator counts, planned and observed spawns, and excluded groups.
sheet_catalog: Reads all 206 verified mappings from the current character sheet. Requires an available sheet instance.
sheet_row: Changes the EpochPact contribution to a mapped stat. Secondary modifiers use the same full stat key as their underlying property.
raw_stat: Edits 134 stat types using SP, tags, special and extra. Increased and More must be at least -1; zero is neutral. Some tag fields are indices.
stat_alias: Uses the catalog's verified stat names, contribution modes and units.
stat_reset: Removes only contributions owned by EpochPact. Controls sharing the same stat key are updated together.
stat_restore: Applies the bonuses remembered for the loaded character again (after a restart or a character load); bonuses the game already has are not sent.
sheet_open: Toggles the game's normal character panel. This also changes its visible state.
resistance_labels: Reads the seven resistance labels from the character panel. Closed or inactive panels may be unavailable or show stale values.
progress_read: Reads the loaded character's identity, level, XP, quest rewards, eligibility and actual waypoint scenes.
campaign_complete: Complete main + side campaign · level 55 minimum

Completes unfinished eligible campaign quests with their normal rewards and raises the character to at least level 55. Unlocks End of Time, MonolithHub and M_Rest waypoints. Completed quests do not grant rewards again. If you have no mastery, use Choose Mastery afterward.
mastery_choose: Open the game's mastery selection screen, then choose and confirm in the game. Available after The Power of Mastery is completed. An existing mastery is never replaced by this action.
waypoints_unlock: Unlocks actual waypoint scenes. Monolith timeline difficulty unlocks are a separate action.
monolith_read: Reads all 10 timelines and 20 difficulties, their limits, unlocks, current runs and selected timeline.
monolith_unlock: Unlocks every Normal and Empowered timeline. Already unlocked entries are skipped.
monolith_select: Selects the timeline and difficulty through the normal game panel. This explicit action travels to Traveler's Rest through its unlocked waypoint first. It does not start an Echo.
corruption: Sets the selected timeline and difficulty's absolute Corruption value. Limits are read from the current game assets.
stability: Sets the selected timeline and difficulty's absolute Stability value. The upper limit is read from the current game assets.
stability_multiplier: Multiplies positive natural Stability gains. Losses and manually set absolute values are unchanged.
cof_read: Reads rank, Favor, Reputation, prophecy slots, lenses, reward eligibility and active tuning.
cof_join: Joins Circle of Fortune. Leaving Merchant's Guild requires the separate switch option and ends that membership.
cof_rank: Sets the rank and resets Reputation progress within that rank. Lowering rank can lock prophecy slots and remove bonuses.
cof_favor: Sets the absolute Favor balance. Does not generate Reputation or prophecy progress.
cof_reputation_grant: Adds this amount to existing Reputation. This is not an absolute balance and does not use gain multipliers.
cof_lenses_unlock: Unlocks unpurchased lenses allowed by the current rank through the normal purchase path.
cofpreview: Choose none to clear a reward or lens. Changing a reward resets charges. The same reward or lens cannot occupy both slots.
cofprophecy: Choose none to clear a reward or lens. Changing a reward resets charges. Preview lens changes before applying. The same reward or lens cannot occupy both slots.
cof_charges: Sets 0–99 completed charges without immediately spawning items. Reducing charges also clears fractional progress.
cof_favor_multiplier: Multiplies normal positive Favor gains. Naturally derived Reputation and prophecy progress still apply.
cof_reputation_multiplier: Multiplies Reputation from earning or spending Favor, excluding manual grants. Favor gains combine both gain multipliers.
cof_charge_multiplier: Changes prophecy progress independently of Favor and Reputation balances. Does not raise Tyranny's spending cost.
cof_reward_multiplier: Multiplies the base reward quantity, capped at 250 per normal spawn. Combines with rank 12 and Duplication without consuming extra charges.
cof_exalted_multiplier: Scales the native coefficient, including rank 12's 1.5 bonus, and the actual Rare-to-Exalted chance. This is a multiplier, not a percentage.
cof_t7_multiplier: Scales the native coefficient, including rank 12's 2 bonus. The game's level and tier requirements still apply. This is a multiplier, not a percentage.
cof_lp_multiplier: Applies only to Uniques eligible for the native CoF bonus. LP stays within 0–4 and Weaver's Will exceptions still apply. Does not guarantee a specific LP count.
cof_double_enemy: Sets the chance directly from 0–100%. Zero disables this double chance; Default restores the normal rank bonus.
cof_double_echo: Sets the chance directly from 0–100%. Default restores the normal rank bonus. Normal Tomb, Gold and XP exceptions still apply.
cof_lens_celerity: Scales the extra 50% charge contribution: ×3 gives +150%, for a total ×2.5 charge rate.
cof_lens_charity: Scales the other slot's extra 10% charge contribution: ×5 gives +50%.
cof_lens_duplication: Scales the 40% extra reward chance, capped at 100%.
factions_read: Reads the four factions' rank assets and state. Weaver has up to 13 rank points + 40 echo points = 53. Merchant's Guild and Weaver management actions are not implemented.
session_read: Reads the current game state and whether a transition is in progress.
status: Reads the offline gate, active multipliers, counters and hook errors.
player_read: Reads the name, level and offline status. The quest overview supplies the current save identity.
characters: Reads the normal character selection panel.
play_offline: Uses the normal Login panel after the current transition has finished.
load_character: Opens a normal character tile. Enter the exact name without spaces and optionally the level. Refresh the loaded identity afterwards.
undo: Validates the selected snapshot and loaded character, closes the game normally and restores the backup. Creates a recovery copy of the current save first.
atlas_read: Find owned and missing Uniques and Sets; track your wishlist locally.
stash_read: Compare owned copies, their LP and affixes. Local protection never changes an item.
echo_read: Search actual Echo rewards in the selected timeline. No Echoes are generated.
echo_focus: Focus a visible Echo in the normal game map without starting it. Opens from Traveler's Rest; an explicit action travels there through the normal unlocked waypoint first. It does not start an Echo.
build_read: Read current skill, passive and Weaver budgets and build settings.
build_skillxp: Multiply positive specialised skill XP gains. Character level XP is unchanged by this control.
build_passivepoints: Multiply points earned from levels; quest points stay unchanged. Fractional totals are rounded down, so 1.5× grants three points across two eligible levels.
build_skillpoints: Multiply the skill's total point budget, including gear skill levels. Level 20 plus one gear level at 2× provides 42 points.
build_weaverpoints: Multiply earned Weaver points from rank and Woven Echo progress.
build_weaverflat: Add a fixed number of Weaver points after applying the multiplier.
build_skillnodes: Allow allocation without the preceding skill nodes. Point budgets and individual node caps still apply.
build_passivenodes: Ignore passive connections and mastery gates
Allocate passive nodes without their preceding connections or mastery thresholds. Actual mastery totals, point budgets and node caps are kept.
build_weavernodes: Allow allocation without preceding Weaver nodes. Point budgets and node caps still apply.
build_offhand: Allow weapons in the offhand and remove linked two-handed equipment conflicts. Normal level and class requirements still apply.
build_fullsets: Full set bonuses from one piece
Activate the missing bonuses of each equipped set. Removing its last piece removes the bonuses.
build_primordials: Wear any number of primordial items

Wear more than one primordial item (Primordial Unique or Exalted) and get the bonuses of all of them. Switched off, the game's limit of one returns: while you wear more, their bonuses stop until you take the extra items off.
build_zoom: Move the overhead camera farther away. This changes distance, not field of view; 1× restores the normal distance.
build_projectiles: Multiply player-owned projectile volleys and moving projectile emissions that lack a native extra-projectile component. Each emission group is capped at 64. Beams, stationary areas, summons and enemy attacks are excluded.
build_projectileflat: Add extra projectiles after the multiplier in each projectile emission group. Supports native volleys and retrofitted moving projectiles; does not duplicate beams or stationary areas.
build_summonduration: Extend player-owned summon expiry timers and slow native health decay, including Wraith/Abomination paths. AI, attacks and combat damage remain normal. Permanent minions remain permanent.
build_minionextra: Raise each summon skill's own limit by this many: skeletons, skeletal mages, wraiths, golems, zombies and other minions. Cast the skill again to fill the new places. Totems, ballistas, forged weapons and companions have their own settings.
build_totemextra: Raise each totem skill's own limit by this many (Thorn Totem, Storm Totem, Warcry Totem and other totems).
build_ballistaextra: Raise the Ballista limit by this many.
build_forgedextra: Raise the forged weapon limit by this many.
build_companionextra: Raise your companion limit by this many. The game's other companion rules still apply, such as one of each kind.
build_immortalminions: Your minions, companions, totems and ballistas cannot be killed by damage (the game's own cannot-die state): lethal damage leaves them at 0 health. They still end when their duration runs out or when they are unsummoned. Switching it off gives a minion at 0 health 1 health back.
build_blessingoptions: Choose Normal, 3, 4 or 5 options for newly generated Monolith boss rewards. This does not change existing rewards.
build_blessingrolls: Use the upper roll limit on newly generated boss blessing options. Existing blessings are kept.
craft_custom_catalog: Read public Unique/Set templates, regular affixes and individual modifier lines. Does not create or modify items.
craft_custom: Replace the selected forge item with a recovery backup. Combine a template, regular affixes (T1-T8 with a chosen or random roll; T8 is primordial, one per item) and up to 64 individual Unique/Set modifier lines. Mixed modifiers use one affix slot and require EpochPact plus workshop-recipes.txt on every installation; restore original gear before uninstalling.
spawn_list: Read the base items, Uniques and Sets the game can make. Does not create items.
spawn_item: The game makes the chosen base item, Unique or Set with its own rules and drops it next to your character, like a monster drop. Base items: Normal, Magic, Rare or Exalted. Uniques: the game's Legendary Potential roll or a chosen 0-4 (Weaver's Will Uniques and Sets roll their own). Item level 1-100, up to 20 at a time. Nothing is saved until you pick the items up.
craft_materials_read: Read your current affix shard, rune and glyph quantities.
craft_materials: Raise every current crafting shard, rune and glyph to at least the chosen quantity. Higher quantities are kept. Creates a recovery backup. Saved materials remain available without EpochPact and are shared by characters using the same stash.
build_cameraangle: Set the overhead camera pitch in degrees. Zero uses the game's normal angle. Your saved camera preferences are kept.
qol_read: Read the current world and display controls.
qol_chests: Open eligible world chests within the interaction radius, through the normal interaction. Locked and used chests are skipped.
qol_shrines: Activate eligible shrines within the interaction radius. Native conditions and the normal shrine buff are kept.
qol_portals: Arm a single automatic portal interaction within the interaction radius. Waits 10 seconds after loading and turns off after use to prevent travel loops.
qol_arearadius: How near a chest, shrine or portal must be before it is used: this many game units around it (3 is the earlier fixed distance). The height may differ by up to the same distance, at least 3, so objects on another floor stay out.
qol_areashape: The area around each chest, shrine or portal: a circle, or a square.
qol_areashow: Draw the area around each chest, shrine and portal that will still be used, within 60 game units. An outline disappears once the object is used.
qol_areacolor: Colour of the drawn areas (six hexadecimal digits, for example 3FD0FF).
qol_shadows: Disable rendered shadows for this session. Your saved graphics settings are kept.
qol_reflections: Disable real-time reflection probes and screen-space reflection effects. Existing graphics preferences are restored when disabled.
qol_bloom: Disable bloom in active scene post-processing profiles, without changing saved graphics preferences.
qol_motionblur: Disable motion blur in scene post-processing profiles.
qol_occlusion: Disable ambient occlusion in scene post-processing profiles.
qol_fog: Disable the game's Hx volumetric camera effect for this session. Normal gameplay visibility and saved settings are kept.
pickup_radius: Limits auto pickup to 1–60 game units around your character. At 0, every drop the game has loaded in the current area is collected. Auto pickup pauses while an item tooltip is shown.
summons_read: Read active player-owned allies: health, armour, resistances and measured damage. DPS uses recent applied hits; attack a target to collect a comparison.
inventory_read: Read the loaded character and inventory item count without changing items.
inventory_stash: Use the game's normal inventory interface and transactions. Stash all creates a recovery backup and leaves items that cannot be moved in your inventory.
inventory_vendor: Use the game's normal inventory interface and transactions. Stash all creates a recovery backup and leaves items that cannot be moved in your inventory.
inventory_stashall: Use the game's normal inventory interface and transactions. Stash all creates a recovery backup and leaves items that cannot be moved in your inventory.
inventory_sellall: Sell every inventory item the vendor buys, with the game's own sale (as Ctrl+click on an item). The vendor opens first when it is not open. What Sell all keeps is chosen below; equipped items are never sold. Sold items are in the vendor's buyback list. Creates a recovery backup.
inventory_tools_read: Read the automatic sorting choices and what Sell all keeps.
inventory_autosort: Each time your inventory opens, the game's own Sort runs on it. Remembered by EpochPact.
inventory_autosortall: Each time a stash tab is shown, the game's own Sort runs on it. To sort only some tabs, leave this off and tick them in the list. Remembered by EpochPact.
inventory_sellkeep: Which items Sell all leaves in your inventory. Remembered by EpochPact.
inventory_sorttab: Sort this stash tab each time it is shown, with the game's own Sort. Remembered by EpochPact.
respec_skills: Reset all specialized skill allocations for free. Skill levels and experience are preserved. Creates a recovery backup before refunding points.
respec_passives: Reset passive allocations for free. Earned points, character level and mastery choice are preserved. Creates a recovery backup first.
respec_weaver: Reset Weaver tree allocations for free. Earned points and faction progress are preserved. Creates a recovery backup first.
craft_t7: Upgrade existing T5 and T6 affixes with shards, one tier at a time. Stops at T7. Use plain shards or Basic Glyph of Hope for T6/T7. Material, Forging Potential and level requirements remain.
pickup_interval: How often auto pickup scans for drops: from 0.25 s (default) to 10 s. Longer intervals reduce system load. When the game reports a full inventory, equipment pickup pauses until you open and close your inventory; gold, potions, tomes, bones, materials and everything else continue to be collected.
pickup_now: Collect every drop the game has loaded right now, ignoring the radius. Your pickup rules, categories, loot filter and inventory space still apply. Runs across several frames.
loot_log: Recent item and gold pickups, by you or Auto Pickup: name, rarity and the loot filter rule that matched (the same number the game shows with Item rule numbering). Reading it does not change the game.
loot_log_clear: Clear the recent pickups list. Items and gold are unchanged.
affix_info: What an affix shard's affix does: prefix or suffix, level, the item types it rolls on and the game's value text for each tier. Reading it does not change the game.
map_minimapsize: Scale the corner minimap, including its frame. 1 is the game's size.
map_minimapzoom: Below 1 zooms the corner minimap in, above 1 shows more of the area. 1 is the game's zoom.
map_minimapopacity: Opacity of the corner minimap, its frame and icons. 0 keeps the game's own value.
map_overlayopacity: Opacity of the full-screen overlay map, beyond the game's slider range. 0 keeps your game setting.
map_overlayzoom: Below 1 zooms the overlay map in, above 1 shows more. Extends the game's overlay zoom limits.
tier_icons: Show each affix tier as coloured digits on inventory, stash and equipment icons (for example 7 6 5 4). Display only; items are unchanged.
tier_tooltips: Add a coloured T1-T8 tag in front of each affix in item tooltips. The tags are removed when switched off.
tier_color: Choose the colour for one affix tier (six hexadecimal digits, for example E0315A).
tier_rule_color: Colour of the loot filter rule line in item tooltips: the colour the item's label has on the ground (label), or one colour you choose (six hexadecimal digits, for example E0315A).
tier_read: Read tier display settings, palette and counters.
map_settings_read: Read minimap and overlay display settings.
tier_lines: Colour each affix line in item tooltips with its tier colour. The original text returns when switched off.
stash_rules_read: Read the active loot filter's rules, your stash folders and tabs, and which tab belongs to which rule.
stash_rules_create: Create one stash tab per loot filter rule, free of gold, in a folder named after the filter. Each tab takes the rule's rarity, type, class, level, potential, faction, unique and corruption conditions as its stash priority. Creates a recovery backup.
stash_rule_assign: Link a tab to a rule
Give an existing stash tab the conditions of one loot filter rule as its stash priority, or 0 to clear it. Creates a recovery backup.
stash_rules_sort: Move inventory items into the tab linked to the loot filter rule they match, using the game's exact filter match (affix conditions included). Creates a recovery backup.
categories_read: Read the item categories: which are ticked, their stash tabs, and how many of their items are in the inventory and in each tab.
category_auto: Send picked-up items to the category tab

Items of a ticked category go straight from the ground to its stash tab when you pick them up, with the game's own container move. An item stays in the inventory when the tab is full or the stash is not loaded yet. Remembered by EpochPact.
category_show: Show one category in the inventory
The inventory shows the items of one category as usual and the others faint; none shows every item again. Display only.
category_setup: Create the missing tabs, one per category (EP Unique & Set, EP Exalted, EP Idols, EP Keys & special, EP Weapons, EP Armour, EP Jewellery, EP Other), free of gold, in a stash folder named EpochPact. Tabs you already have are kept. Creates a recovery backup.
category_sort: Move the inventory's items of the ticked categories into their tabs. Items that do not fit stay in the inventory. Creates a recovery backup.
category_open: Open the stash on a category's tab, from anywhere.
category_materials: Open the game's crafting materials panel, or close it when it is open.
font_family: Use a Windows font for the game's interface text; game restores the original fonts. Characters the font lacks use the game's font.
font_scale: Multiply the size of the game's interface text. 1 is the game's size.
font_case: Show names and texts in the letter case they were written in: the game draws many texts in capitals, lower case or small capitals. With the game font lower-case letters still look like small capitals; choose a Windows font above for real lower-case letters. Undone when you switch it off or close EpochPact.
font_read: Read the font choice, Windows font families and counters.
report_read: Read the in-game report hotkey and the reports folder.
report_key: Key that saves a report while the game window is in front: screenshot, game and EpochPact state and recent logs in <game>/EpochPact/reports. Remembered by the mod; off disables it.
report_now: Save the same report as the hotkey, from EpochPact.
damage_session_read: Read the damage session: per ally type and your character, DPS over 10 s, 60 s, 10 min and 60 min, averages, totals and hits.
damage_session: Start, stop or reset the damage session. Damage is only recorded while it runs; stopped values stay until reset.
damage_icon: The game's own skill or class icon for one damage window source, as a small PNG. Reading it does not change the game.
rage_read: Read the Rage of Morditas values the game uses now and its own ones: encounter chance, hunt time, kills for Bloodrage charges and hunt buffs, Blood forging potential share.
rage_spawn: Multiplies the chance of a Rage of Morditas Blood Crystal in a zone. In each zone that can have one (many campaign zones and normal Monolith echoes) the game rolls 30 % times the zone's own factor, about 0.9 to 3.3; from 4 every such zone gets one.
rage_hunttime: Multiplies the hunt's starting time (the game's 20–25 s) and the time each kill adds (0.5 / 2 / 3 s for normal, magic and rare monsters, 10 s for a champion). The game itself gives a kill less time the longer the hunt already is.
rage_charges: The share of hunt kills needed for each Bloodrage charge: the game's 20, 50, 90, 140 and 200 kills at 1; 0.5 halves them, 0.2 needs a fifth. There are still five charges.
rage_buffs: The share of hunt kills needed for each random hunt buff: the game's 20, 50, 90 and 140 kills at 1.
rage_blood: Every Rage of Morditas reward item gets Ice or Blood forging potential; this is how many get Blood. The game's own share is 50 %. The Rituals of Ice and Blood still give their own type.
death_recap_read: The last deaths since the game started: the hits of the 10 seconds before each (attacker, skill or ailment, damage by type, health and ward after) and the buffs and debuffs shown at the death. Reading it does not change the game.
death_recap: Keep the hits your character takes so the death recap can show the 10 seconds before each death. On by default; the hits are only kept in memory until the game closes.
death_recap_clear: Forget the recorded deaths. The game is unchanged.
tier_rules: Show which loot filter rule matches an item in its tooltip: rule number, Show/Hide/Highlight and the rule name, in the colour the rule gives the item's label.
tier_rule_position: Where the loot filter rule line appears in item tooltips: under the item type, before the affixes, or at the end of the tooltip.
tier_rule_parts: What the loot filter rule line in item tooltips shows: the "Loot filter:" label, the rule number, Show, Hide or Highlight, and the rule name. For a rule without a name the game's own description is used, without its "Show All" or "Hide All" words.
tier_filter_colors: 26 more colours in the game's loot filter window for label and beam colours (pinks, violets, blues, teals, greens, golds, oranges, reds, browns and greys), after the game's own. A filter saved with one of them shows the game's last colour where EpochPact does not run. Off: the game's own colours.
tier_name_colors: Colours in loot filter rule names

Colour words in your loot filter rule names: put a colour tag before a word and a closing colour tag after it, or bold, italic, underline and strikethrough tags (examples below). Colours: red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, white, black or a #RRGGBB code. The game's filter window and the rule line in item tooltips show them; other tags stay plain text. Off: the game's own display.
tier_special: Mark Personal, Champion and Experimental affixes

Put a small coloured square before Personal (sky blue), Champion (amber) and Experimental (orchid) affix lines in item tooltips, so they stand apart from regular affixes. Shown with the tier tags or tier colours.
effects_enabled: Show live effect names, game icons, stack counts and available timers while playing. Click-through, offline and session only.
effects_player: Show the buffs and debuffs exposed by the game's own player effect UI.
effects_target: Show the ailments exposed by the currently displayed target's native health bar. Changing target clears the previous effects.
effects_descriptions: Show a short description read from the game's effect definition. Unknown values are not estimated.
effects_scale: Scale the effect panels. Their row count is limited to the available screen space.
effects_rows: Limit rows per panel; additional active effects are counted below the visible rows. This does not limit which game icons can appear.
effects_read: Read effect HUD settings and availability without enabling it.

merchants_guild_management: Information only. Management actions are not implemented.
weaver_rank_amber_tree: Rank and earned points can be read. Amber wallet, rank, node and Woven management actions are not implemented. Maximum: 13 rank points + 40 echo points = 53.
permanent_profiles: Native mod settings are not saved as permanent profiles. UI profiles store drafts; loading a draft does not apply it to the game. Use Apply changes explicitly.
